newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: African ministers prepare agenda for OAU summit.
newsitem.headline: African ministers prepare agenda for OAU summit.

text.p: African foreign ministers were meeting behind closed doors on Friday to prepare an agenda for an Organisation of African Unity summit taking place in Harare next week, which officials said would focus on political problems and economic issues.
OAU spokesman Ibrahim Dagash said some 42 ministers from the 53-member organisation were attending the two-day conference ending later on Friday.

The June 2-4 summit is expected to be attended by some 40 heads of state and government, including Laurent Kabila of the Democratic Republic of Congo whose forces drove out former Zairean president Mobutu Sese Seko.
The recent crisis in Great Lakes region, the coup in Sierra Leone and political developments in Somalia and Angola are among the issues the African leaders will address.
Dagash said Africa's quest to establish a common market in the next century would also be one of the main topics.
